description_zh: 在夜晚的十字路口，ego车辆（直行的van）与一辆对向左转车辆（NPC）发生碰撞，碰撞发生在ego直行、NPC左转进入ego车道的过程中。源于Waymo AV手动左转时与对向van碰撞的事故报告。

source_snippets: On October 28, 2021 at 9:35 PM PDT a Waymo Autonomous Vehicle... was in a collision involving a van at Silver Avenue at Bayshore Boulevard.
the test driver... proceeded with a left turn manually. During the left turn, an approaching van made contact with the front bumper of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: van直行（ego）与对向左转车辆（v2）在路口冲突，可用junction_turn表达NPC行为，position为oncoming。
